svg.title: OmniRoute Quick Start
svg.desc: 1. Before you install. Supported Node.js. 22.22.2 and later 22.x, or 24.x, 25.x, 26.x Check with node --version. 2. Terminal. Install and start. npm install -g omniroute omniroute Dashboard http://localhost:20128, API /v1 3. Browser. Password and provider. Set a dashboard password in first-run setup. Dashboard → Providers → add a key or sign in. 4. Browser. Create an OmniRoute key. Dashboard → API Keys → Create API Key Shown once. For your tools, not a provider key. 5. Terminal. First request. POST /v1/chat/completions with model auto. GET /v1/models lists what your key can reach. 6. Your coding tool. Point it at OmniRoute. omniroute configure codex omniroute run claude --model auto

g.text: Set a dashboard password in first-run setup.
Dashboard → Providers → add a key or sign in.
Dashboard → API Keys → Create API Key
Shown once. For your tools, not a provider key.
GET /v1/models lists what your key can reach.
